en.title: Dwayne Johnson Sings 'Happy Birthday' to Daughter Simone After Disney Legend Honor
en.summary: The Rock was officially inducted as a Disney Legend at D23, a moment made even more special by a heartwarming family serenade. After accepting the prestigious award, Johnson gathered the crowd to celebrate his daughter Simone's birthday.
en.body:
The charismatic **Dwayne Johnson**, a titan of both the wrestling ring and the silver screen, has officially joined the hallowed ranks of **Disney Legends**. At the recent D23 Expo, the Walt Disney Company bestowed this distinguished honor upon the action star, recognizing his significant contributions to the magical world of Disney. From his electrifying performance as Maui in the animated blockbuster **Moana** to his adventures in **Jungle Cruise** and the **Race to Witch Mountain** franchise, Johnson has become an integral part of the Disney universe.

After taking the stage to accept the award, a visibly moved Johnson expressed his gratitude. The ceremony, held at the Ultimate Disney Fan Event, celebrated individuals who have made extraordinary contributions to Disney. This induction cements Johnson's legacy among an elite group of entertainers who have shaped the company's storied history. He has long been a beloved figure for his roles in Disney films, bringing his signature charisma and energy to each character.

## A Birthday Surprise at D23

But the evening held a special, unexpected twist. As the applause for his Disney Legend award began to fade, **Dwayne Johnson** turned the spotlight onto his own family. He led the assembled crowd in a rousing rendition of "Happy Birthday" for his daughter, **Simone Johnson**, who was also in attendance. This spontaneous moment underscored Johnson's dedication to his family, even amidst a career-defining achievement. It was a powerful display of his dual role as a global superstar and a devoted father, blending his professional triumph with a cherished personal milestone.

> "Been a wonderful few decades watching since WWE -F and great actor, humanitarian, and father of the year definitely is yours. Family is always"

This heartwarming gesture resonated deeply, showcasing a side of The Rock that fans cherish. It transformed a prestigious industry award ceremony into an intimate family celebration, demonstrating that even for someone as larger-than-life as **Dwayne Johnson**, family remains paramount.

## What's Next for The Rock

While details about **Simone Johnson**'s upcoming projects have not yet been announced, **Dwayne Johnson** continues to be a dominant force in entertainment. Fans can look forward to his continued involvement in major film franchises and his ongoing work with Disney. His induction as a Disney Legend is just the latest chapter in an extraordinary career, promising more unforgettable moments both on and off screen.
